config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.expup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "explicit-secret"

[providers.catup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "catalog-secret"

[[models]]
name = "old-cat"
provider = "expup"
model = "old-up"
enabled = false

[catalog]
url = "{UPSTREAM}/catalog"
timeout = 5
refresh_seconds = 0
headers = { "X-Catalog-Token" = "cat-secret" }

[catalog.model_providers]
"old-cat" = "catup"
name: m4_catalog_disabled_reserved
